Allow Reading of Courses.name: Allow Reading of Courses
Allow Reading of Courses.using:
EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM
          user_school_memberships usm
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.get_current_school_id() as current_school_id) as app_context
        WHERE
          usm.user_id = auth.uid() AND
          usm.school_id = "courses"."school_id" AND
          (
            app_context.current_school_id IS NULL OR
            usm.school_id = app_context.current_school_id
          )
      )

Allow Access to Non-Private Notes for St.name: Allow Access to Non-Private Notes for Students in User Schools
Allow Access to Non-Private Notes for St.using:
"meeting_notes"."private" = false
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM user_school_memberships AS usm
        JOIN school_student_link AS ssl
          ON usm.school_id = ssl.school_id
        WHERE usm.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND ssl.student_id = "meeting_notes"."student_id"
      )

Allow Reading of Schools.name: Allow Reading of Schools
Allow Reading of Schools.using:
EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM user_school_memberships usm
        WHERE usm.user_id = auth.uid()
        AND usm.school_id = "schools"."school_id"
      )

Allow Reading of Section Enrollments.name: Allow Reading of Section Enrollments
Allow Reading of Section Enrollments.using:
EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sections s
            JOIN courses c ON s.course_id = c.course_id
            JOIN user_school_memberships usm ON usm.school_id = c.school_id
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.get_current_school_id() as current_school_id) as app_context
            WHERE s.section_id = "section_enrollments"."section_id"
            AND usm.user_id = auth.uid()
            AND (
                app_context.current_school_id IS NULL OR
                c.school_id = app_context.current_school_id
            )
        )
